主要内容: On June 17, 2013, Novavax, Inc. filed a Registration Statement on Form S-4 with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). This filing relates to the company's previously announced offer for the shares and warrants of Isconova AB. Isconova AB also filed a press release announcing Novavax's intent to file the Registration Statement. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.
